source: REAL `idb ui describe-all --json` of iOS's "Open in “AveriLab”?" confirmation over SpringBoard: batch-5 D49A E2 (2026-11-02, main 28c1d37d, lab simulator iPhone 17, iOS 27.0, 402x874 pt), case-main-idb-E2-idb-flat.
